## PluginLessonFormat

Public SDK type, exported as `PluginLessonFormat`. Import with `import type`; the SDK has no runtime exports.

Optional lesson choices contributed through the existing plugin activation.

```ts
export type PluginLessonFormat = {
    id: string;
    label: string;
    instructions: string;
} & ({
    kind: "quiz";
    questionTypeId: string;
} | {
    kind: "workflow";
    explanation: "before-questions" | "after-first-answer";
} | {
    kind: "output" | "diagram";
    language: string;
});
```
